_meta.note: Only display real hardware items with verified vendor details and prices. Never invent prices or vendors.

promise.en: We recommend suitable hardware and connect you directly to the vendor at the real price.
promise.si: නිවැරදි hardware නිර්දේශ කිරීමෙන් පසු ඔබව සැබෑ මිලට vendor සමඟ කෙලින්ම සම්බන්ධ කරමු.

displayRules: Show only items where verified is true.
Require vendor name, contact and verified vendor price.
Show vendor price directly without hidden markup.
Do not show unavailable or unverified stock information.
Hide the entire hardware page and navigation link when there are no verified items.
supportBoundary: Hardware warranty claims and physical hardware failures are handled by the hardware vendor. Software support is handled according to the agreed software support policy.
